def mv(arm, pose):
    r = primitives.call(name='move_robotwin2_arm', arm_tag=arm, target_pose=pose, evidence_handles=handles)
    print("move", arm, [round(v,3) for v in pose[:3]], "ok", r.ok, short(r.output, 300) if not r.ok else "")
    p = primitives.call(name='inspect_robotwin2_arm_pose', arm_tag=arm)
    if p.ok:
        print("  ee now", short(p.output, 250))
    return r

def grip(arm, cmd):
    r = primitives.call(name='set_robotwin2_gripper', arm_tag=arm, command=cmd, evidence_handles=handles)
    print("grip", arm, cmd, "ok", r.ok, "" if r.ok else short(r.output, 300))
    return r

def loc(lbl):
    r = primitives.call(name='locate_robotwin2_actor', actor_name=lbl)
    if r.ok:
        print("loc", lbl, short(r.output, 300))
    return r

TD = [-0.5, 0.5, -0.5, -0.5]
b2 = measures["block2"]["centroid_world"]
print("b2", b2)
grip("right", "open")
mv("right", [b2[0], b2[1], 0.90] + TD)
mv("right", [b2[0], b2[1], 0.80] + TD)
loc("block2")

def mvd(arm, d):
    r = primitives.call(name='move_robotwin2_arm', arm_tag=arm, delta=d, move_axis='world', evidence_handles=handles)
    p = primitives.call(name='inspect_robotwin2_arm_pose', arm_tag=arm)
    z = p.output['pose_world'][:3] if p.ok else None
    print("delta", arm, d, "ok", r.ok, "" if r.ok else short(r.output, 200), "ee", [round(v,3) for v in z] if z else None)
    return z

def blockpos(lbl):
    r = primitives.call(name='locate_robotwin2_actor', actor_name=lbl)
    if r.ok and isinstance(r.output, dict):
        for c in r.output.get('candidates', []):
            if c.get('name') == lbl:
                return [round(v,3) for v in c['pose_world'][:3]]
    return None

# descend stepwise with displacement
z = mvd("right", [0, 0, -0.05])
z = mvd("right", [0, 0, -0.05])
if z and z[2] > 0.82:
    z = mvd("right", [0, 0, -0.03])
grip("right", "close")
z = mvd("right", [0, 0, 0.08])
print("block2 after lift", blockpos("block2"))
# move to medium slot: x=0, y=-0.1
cur = primitives.call(name='inspect_robotwin2_arm_pose', arm_tag='right').output['pose_world']
mv("right", [0.0, -0.1, cur[2]] + TD)
z = mvd("right", [0, 0, -0.05])
z = mvd("right", [0, 0, -0.03])
grip("right", "open")
z = mvd("right", [0, 0, 0.08])
print("block2 final", blockpos("block2"), "block3", blockpos("block3"), "block1", blockpos("block1"))

def pick_place(arm, lbl, tgt):
    p = blockpos(lbl)
    print(lbl, "at", p)
    grip(arm, "open")
    mv(arm, [p[0], p[1], 0.95] + TD)
    mv(arm, [p[0], p[1], 0.80] + TD)
    z = mvd(arm, [0, 0, -0.04])
    grip(arm, "close")
    z = mvd(arm, [0, 0, 0.09])
    print(lbl, "after lift", blockpos(lbl))
    cur = primitives.call(name='inspect_robotwin2_arm_pose', arm_tag=arm).output['pose_world']
    mv(arm, [tgt[0], tgt[1], cur[2]] + TD)
    mv(arm, [tgt[0], tgt[1], 0.80] + TD)
    grip(arm, "open")
    z = mvd(arm, [0, 0, 0.09])
    print(lbl, "final", blockpos(lbl))

pick_place("right", "block3", [0.1, -0.1])
pick_place("left", "block1", [-0.1, -0.1])
print("all:", blockpos("block1"), blockpos("block2"), blockpos("block3"))
